stages.name: Heat spreader
stages.detail: A nickel lid draws heat away from the silicon.

stages.name: Silicon die
stages.detail: The patterned silicon beneath the lid contains the processor’s circuits.

stages.name: Package substrate
stages.detail: Copper traces fan signals out from the die to the contact pads.

stages.name: Socket contacts
stages.detail: Rows of spring contacts connect the package to the board.

stages.name: Exploded assembly
stages.detail: Lid, die, substrate, and socket share a single alignment axis.
